mapper.select: SELECT ID, SUBJECT, CONTENT, EMAIL, VIEW_CNT, TO_CHAR(CRT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CRT_DT, TO_CHAR(MDFY_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS MDFY_DT, FILE_NAME, ORIGIN_FILE_NAME FROM BOARD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD (ID, SUBJECT, CONTENT, EMAIL, VIEW_CNT, CRT_DT, MDFY_DT, FILE_NAME, ORIGIN_FILE_NAME) VALUES ('BO-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD-') || LPAD(SEQ_BOARD_PK.NEXTVAL, 6, '0'), #{subject}, #{content}, #{email}, 0, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, null, null )
mapper.select: SELECT ID, SUBJECT, CONTENT, EMAIL, VIEW_CNT, TO_CHAR(CRT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CRT_DT, TO_CHAR(MDFY_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS MDFY_DT, FILE_NAME, ORIGIN_FILE_NAME FROM BOARD WHERE ID = #{_parameter}
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET SUBJECT = #{subject}, CONTENT = #{content}, EMAIL = #{email}, MDFY_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{id}
